target.title: feat(gateway): include produced messageId on chat final/aborted events
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Today the Gateway `final` (and `aborted`) chat event carries only `runId`, `sessionKey`, `state` — nothing about *what* the run produced. External clients (e.g. the Open WebUI pipe) must re-fetch the transcript and guess "the last assistant message", which is decoupled from the run and causes **duplicate proactive deliveries**: a background run (heartbeat/sub-agent/yield) ends with a contentless `final`, the client re-ships the transcript tail under a new `runId`, and the same message is persisted twice.

This adds an optional, stable `messageId` to the `final`/`aborted` events so clients can dedup deterministically on `(sessionKey, messageId)` instead of re-deriving the last transcript entry.

Closes #105593.

## Changes

- **`packages/gateway-protocol`** — add optional `messageId` to `ChatFinalEventSchema` and `ChatAbortedEventSchema` (`additionalProperties: false` preserved).
- **`src/gateway/server-chat.ts`** — thread the produced `messageId` through the agent-event handler onto the emitted final/aborted payload.
- **`src/gateway/server-methods/chat.ts`** — populate `messageId` from the appended message on the synchronous final payload.
- Tests added in `server.agent.gateway-server-agent-b.test.ts`.

Fully additive and backward-compatible — the field is optional; clients that ignore it are unaffected.

## Evidence

Targeted gateway tests run locally against this branch (rebased on latest `main`):

```
$ node scripts/test-projects.mjs src/gateway/server.agent.gateway-server-agent-b.test.ts
 Test Files  2 passed (2)
      Tests  32 passed (32)
 Duration  84.17s
```

Diff is small (+85/−2, 6 files). Full repo typecheck + suite deferred to CI (the native `tsgo` typecheck OOMs on my local 8 GB machine; CI has the authoritative run).
